result.stdout:
bearing 0.1.0 - Iron Marten

  bearing <solution.sln> [options]

  --include-tests            analyse projects that look like test projects
  --exclude-path <fragment>  skip files whose path contains this
  --no-default-excludes      drop the built-in exclusions instead of adding to them
  --json <file>              also write the whole model as JSON
  --csv <dir>                also write types.csv, members.csv, edges.csv
  --html <file>              also write the shareable single-file report
  --diagram <file.svg>       also write the project map, for pasting into chat
  --mosaic <file.svg>        also write the mosaic: every type as one cell
  --plot <file.svg>          also write the plot: projects by reach and density
  --acknowledge <file>       findings marked known and fine, one key per line
                             (default: .bearing/acknowledged beside the solution)
  --full                     enumerate every finding instead of one per kind
  --profile                  also print, to stderr, where the run's time went
  --version                  print the version and exit

  Thresholds — every value the report cites can be moved:
  --min-cohort                       default 5
  --cohort-basis-floor               default 5
  --min-fan-in                       default 5
  --top                              default 15
  --high-cc                          default 10
  --min-decision-cc                  default 5
  --concealed-top-rank               default 3
  --concealed-top-share              default 0.2
  --concealed-dispersion-factor      default 3
  --hub-min                          default 5
  --god-object-members               default 20
  --min-kind-span                    default 3
  --stable-threshold                 default 0.2
  --isolated-threshold               default 0.8
  --breaks-alone-min-fan-in          default 1
  --concealed-fan-in-ceiling         default 2
  --concealed-fan-out-ceiling        default 2
  --blast-fan-in-multiple            default 2
  --blast-top-fraction
